metadata.name: KeyedTranslations
metadata.description: Declares a library's own texts by stable key — a button label, a pager range, a validation message — each with its source wording, the values it is formatted with and a hint for the translator. It registers a kind whose resources translate those keys into one language, checked per key.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Each key's source wording in the module's `lang:`: a message, or `{ message, values?, description? }`. The declared kind's `messages:` translates exactly these keys.

values.title: Values
values.description: The values whoever shows the text formats it with, by name, each a JSON Schema typed `string`, `integer` or `number`. Without it the text is formatted with no values.

description.title: Description
description.description: A hint for the translator: where the text is shown and what it means.
